scenario: A program under the `default` dialect compiles a series aggregation read. A dialect does not gate series backings in v1. [NSBK.2.3] fixes the seven magics and makes libds's implementation of each the only one that runs, so every conforming runtime carries all of them and [LSER.13.13]'s `the file's dialect bundles no backend providing it` states a condition that cannot arise. The fixture carries no `use` line, so the harness compiles it under `use default` (a file with none is a library, [LDIA.2.10.1]). A compiler that gates a series read on its dialect's backings fails this with DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_NO_BACKEND_FOR_MAGIC.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Float mutable
    ts: Time

series Sensor.val:
    mean sliding 10_min

rule check:
    Sensor s where s.mean > 5.0
->
    log info "high"
